full_prompt_en: The image is a monochrome photographic theater lighting scene, with several white spotlights cutting through a nearly black stage and forming patterned pools on the floor. The background is an uninterrupted dark void except for faint equipment and rigging near the right edge. At the upper-left, a line of small lamps follows a diagonal support, each source creating a distinct pale cone. The beams descend at different angles, with the longest reaching toward the lower middle and the shorter ones landing nearer the left side. Their edges remain visible in the darkness, softened slightly by haze. Across the lower half, oval pools of light stretch along a matte stage surface, overlapping in patterned patches. A few bright patches sit close together on the left, while a broader pool opens near the centre. Between them, wide strips of floor remain nearly black. At the far right, a low technical tower and a few dim rectangular forms break the otherwise empty horizon line. The stage floor itself is smooth and slightly reflective, catching faint gradients around each lit area. The arrangement has no visible performers, furniture or scenery; the beams and their illuminated patches provide the only strong forms. The lighting is cool white and directional, brightest at the fixtures and softer where it spreads across the floor. Subtle gray edges define the cones without turning them into solid bars, and the surrounding black retains a deep, even tone. The contrast is strongest between the small brilliant sources and the broad unlit space. The composition is wide and sparse, with diagonal rays counterbalanced by horizontal pools and the low floor plane. The isolated equipment at right gives the darkness a slight sense of depth, while the repeated beams lead the eye toward the open centre. Its mood is quiet and expectant, as if the stage is prepared but still empty.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅黑白摄影式剧场灯光场景，数束白色聚光灯划过近乎全黑的舞台，并在地面形成成组图案光池。背景几乎是一片完整暗场，只有右侧边缘附近隐约显出设备和灯架。左上方，一排小灯沿倾斜支架排列，每个光源都投下一道浅色光锥。光束以不同角度向下延伸，最长的一束指向下方中央，较短的几束落在更靠左的位置。它们的边缘在黑暗中仍清楚可辨，只被薄雾稍稍柔化。下半部的舞台地面上，椭圆形光池沿横向铺开，形成交叠图案亮斑。左侧有几片相邻的亮斑，中央附近则出现一片更宽的光区，其间留着大片近乎黑色的地面。最右侧，低矮的技术设备塔和几块暗淡矩形轮廓打破空旷地平线。舞台表面平滑并略带反光，每处受光区域周围都显出微弱渐层。画面中没有表演者、家具或布景；光束及其映在地面的亮色构成全部醒目形体。光线呈冷白色且具有方向性，在灯具处最亮，落到地面后柔和扩散。细微灰色边缘勾出光锥，却没有令它们变成实心光柱，周围黑暗保持深沉均匀。反差最强处是明亮小光源与大片未受光空间之间。构图宽阔而稀疏，斜向光束与横向光池、低矮地面相互平衡。右侧孤立设备给黑暗带来些许纵深，重复光束则将视线引向开放的中央。整体气氛安静而蓄势待发，仿佛舞台已经准备好，却仍空无一人。
style_prompt_en: The style is defined by high-contrast darkness and narrow, directional bands of light. Bright sources remain small and precise, while their beams widen and soften through a dark field before meeting a surface. Cool white and faint gray dominate, with little color variation. Light pools repeat the direction of the rays and create rhythm across open space; large unlit areas give each illuminated shape room to read. Edges are softened by subtle haze, while the deepest shadows stay even and uncluttered. The composition favors diagonal lines above flatter horizontal planes, producing depth with very few visible elements. Its effect is restrained, spatial and anticipatory.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格由高反差暗部与窄而有方向性的光带构成。明亮光源小而清楚，光束穿过暗色空间后逐渐变宽、柔化，最终落在表面上。冷白和微弱灰色占主导，色彩变化很少。表面的光池重复光束方向，在开放空间中形成节奏；大片未受光区域则让每个亮形都清楚可辨。边缘被细微雾气柔化，最深阴影依然均匀、干净。构图偏向以斜线置于平缓的水平面之上，用极少可见元素构成纵深。整体效果克制、具有空间感，并带有蓄势待发的气氛。
theme_en: White spotlights and patterned pools of light across an empty dark stage
theme_zh: 空旷暗舞台上的白色聚光束与图案光斑
name: Stage lighting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
